title: Building a lab with a client, a server and a target

videos.script: Everything so far has been one guest at a time. A real support problem involves at least two machines: the one somebody is sitting at, and the one that stopped answering. {{two}} In this lesson you build a small lab with three machines on a network of their own. A client, where you sit. A server that works, so you know what right looks like. And a target that has been broken on purpose. {{three}} Then you practise: find what is wrong with the target, fix it, and check from the client that it works. {{practise}} And one snapshot turns that into an exercise you can repeat as often as you like, because the fault comes back with a single command. {{repeat}}
